title: Measure bias in fast decision models, on any hardware, with replayable evidence
description: The whole programme. A public benchmark of System 1 decision models (text in, typed question, a probability per option, no reasoning): causal counterfactuals on real text with control floors, reported in the decision's own currency, replayed offline from a committed answer record. Owns the harness and the studies; the engines it covers are tracked in the sibling initiative Expand model coverage (BD-250c97).
right_now_summary: The harness is adding bias tests while teams replay Jev-Flywheel studies and run Laya comparisons.
